{{Top|leg}}
'''Dresdin''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray stick]], Dresdin expressed the opinion that they were the most effective non-lethal weapon on the market, but expensive unless used against a high-value [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
